verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents a REST API and publishes an llms.txt index and markdown versions of its docs pages. Those are human/LLM-readable documentation, not a machine-readable API specification. The probe found 404s at every common OpenAPI/Swagger path, and no evidence item mentions a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
